cohort_scope: ELIANA/ENSIGN pooled 137; overlaps original ELIANA report
observation: All CR/CRi responders had B-cell aplasia; nearly all responders received immunoglobulin replacement
observation_window_and_adequacy: Longer follow-up than earlier reports; late infection finding is under supportive care; exact endpoint-specific at-risk denominators not extracted
working_interpretation: Observed on-target normal-cell depletion; severe injury consequences require separate coding; not a no-injury observation
location_and_access: Primary indexed full-text Discussion and primary PDF abstract inspected; direct full-page retrieval intermittently blocked

cohort_scope: 40 ongoing responders after anti-BCMA CAR-T; separate study, not assumed ide-cel/cilta-cel
observation: Normal marrow plasma cells first redetected at median day 212; 23/40 patients had 44 infections, with 21 severe and 1 life-threatening infection events
observation_window_and_adequacy: Responder-selected cohort; infection percentages use events, not patients; conditioning and other contributors prevent assigning all infections to target-mediated depletion
working_interpretation: Evidence of prolonged normal-cell loss and immune deficiency; contextual supporting evidence, not a replacement outcome for historical named agents
location_and_access: Primary abstract and indexed full-text Infection events section; direct PMC open blocked

observation: Antitumor response reported; representative safety extraction previously documented grade 3/4 events
observation_window_and_adequacy: Abstract reports median follow-up 11.8 months; target-specific injury ascertainment and endpoint-evaluable denominator not established from abstract
working_interpretation: Indeterminate for absence of target-mediated normal-tissue injury; full immune recovery/infection tables still needed
location_and_access: Primary abstract rechecked; grade details inherited from pass 3, not newly adjudicated

cohort_scope: 27 regionally treated patients; 18 MPM patients subsequently received pembrolizumab
observation: Authors explicitly report no observed on-target/off-tumor toxicity; circulating CAR cells >100 days in 39%
observation_window_and_adequacy: Regional route, variable persistence and combination subcohort limit transportability; exact uniform injury-observation window and missingness not extracted
working_interpretation: Explicit nonobservation in this context, with incomplete adequacy extraction; cannot generalize to all mesothelin agents
location_and_access: Primary abstract, Patients and Treatment, and indexed Discussion inspected

observation: Table 2: dry mouth 205/529 any grade and 0/529 grade >=3
observation_window_and_adequacy: CTCAE v5; treatment-emergent window ends up to 30 days after last randomized treatment or before subsequent anticancer therapy; median radioligand exposure 6.9 months; authors discuss window limitations
working_interpretation: Explicit nonobservation of severe dry mouth only; not absence of all target-mediated injury
location_and_access: Primary Safety, Table 2 including footnote, and Discussion inspected

cohort_scope: ALFA-0701 final safety update; as-treated groups 131 GO and 137 control; overlaps earlier ALFA report
observation: Thrombocytopenia led to discontinuation in 20/131 versus 0/137; severe hemorrhage in 30/131 versus 13/137
observation_window_and_adequacy: Retrospective collection of selected safety events and laboratory data; cessation affected by protocol amendment; no serious hemorrhage reported in the 20 thrombocytopenia-discontinuation patients
working_interpretation: Clinically consequential marrow toxicity is documented; recovery alone cannot justify a negative; specific normal-tissue target-recognition mechanism remains unresolved
location_and_access: Primary Safety analyses, Safety and Discussion inspected; final report counts must not be substituted silently into initial report
